title: Castelion header
description: A fixed, transparent bar in cream over the hero film: an italic wordmark left, four plain nav links right (a 3-line menu button on phones), and under them a full-width 2px rule ending in a small dart tip. On load the rule draws itself left to right as the dart flies to its end, the wordmark fades in and the links rise in one by one. It slides up out of view when you scroll down and drops back, on the navy band colour, when you scroll up.
notes: fixed to the top and transparent at first: made to sit over castelion-hero's film (66px tall on phones, 110px on desktop)
always dark-scoped (cream text); once scrolled it takes the navy band colour (bg-secondary)
needs JavaScript for hide-on-scroll and the phone menu; the load-in is CSS and off with reduced motion
name: castelion-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as an italic wordmark

props.name: links
props.description: the nav links (a drop-down panel on phones)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of the phone menu button, e.g. "Menu"

props.name: hideAfter
props.description: how far down (in window heights) the page must scroll before the bar slides away
